描述_EN: the bottle is a cylindrical form with a very short flared neck and no stopper. the wide flat neck surface suggests a purpose-made snuff bottle. it is made of porcelain, with decoration in underglaze blue. the receding foot, unlglazed at the edge, has a curved indentation underneath containing a mark of a dragon in underglaze blue. the decoration depicts two dragons, with clouds and waves, chasing a flaming pearl.
描述_ZN: 该瓶为圆柱形，颈部很短，没有盖子。 宽平的颈部表面表明是特制的鼻烟壶。 它是由瓷器制成的，有釉里红的装饰。 退足，边缘无釉，下面有一个弧形的压痕，含有釉下青花的龙纹。 纹饰描绘了两条龙，有云彩和波浪，追逐着一颗燃烧的珍珠。
